definitions.gloss: to fight, to quarrel, to argue
definitions.explanation: To have a fight or argument with someone. Can refer to physical fights or verbal arguments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧けんかします。
examples.english: I often fight with my siblings.

examples.japanese: けんかしないで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧けんかしてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up having a fight with my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧けんか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I could hear the sounds of a fight coming from the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧けんかした⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{仲直|なかなお}り→仲直り：03127_nakanaori⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦そうです→そうです：03098_soudesu⟧。
examples.english: The two of them fought yesterday, but I hear they've already made up.

notes:
けんか can be written as ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧ in kanji but is very often written in hiragana.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: けんかする

COMMON PATTERNS:
- けんか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a fight (with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)
- けんかする: to fight (casual)
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧けんかする: to fight with someone

RELATED WORDS:
- けんか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to pick a fight
- けんか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to accept a fight
- ⟦けんか{別|わか}れ→けんか別れ：noentry⟧: parting after a quarrel
- ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦げんか→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧: marital quarrel

⟦{口|くち}げんか→口げんか：08454_kuchigenka⟧ means verbal argument, while just けんか can mean physical or verbal.
